clips.title: Nexus Repository OSS Walkthrough: Setting up a proxy repository
clips.why: You see a real Nexus proxy repository being created: a name, an upstream URL and a blob store, which is all our npm mirror is.
look: The remote storage URL is the upstream; the sandbox never sees it.
The proxy repository has no packages until someone asks for one.
Where the downloaded copies are stored.
clips.after: Our npm mirror is one of these, named npmjs, with registry.npmjs.org as its upstream, next to the PyPI proxy Nexus already runs.

clips.title: How to Setup a Pull Through Image Cache in Kubernetes | Cloud Posse Explains
clips.why: A short discussion of the same idea for container images: a registry that pulls from Docker Hub once and serves its copy afterwards.
look: Why teams cache Docker Hub images at all: rate limits and reliability.
The cluster pulls from the cache, not from Docker Hub.
The cache is just another registry address in front of the image name.
clips.after: In the ai-agents account ECR plays this role through pull-through cache rules, so FCP Lab pulls postgres over the VM's private endpoints.

practice.q: Complete the sandbox's .npmrc so every install goes to the Nexus mirror.
practice.hint: The npm setting that names where packages come from.
practice.why: registry replaces registry.npmjs.org for every npm command, and the lockfile records the mirror's address.

practice.q: Two sandbox VMs install the same new package ten minutes apart. Where does the second one get it from?

options.why: The first request made the mirror fetch and keep it. Later requests are served from that copy.

options.text: From registry.npmjs.org, through the mirror again
options.why: Only a missing package makes the mirror go upstream.
VMs never share anything; each one is fresh and talks only to the mirror.

practice.q: Put the path of one npm ci request from the sandbox in order.
items: npm on the VM reads registry from .npmrc
The request goes to the egress proxy, because HTTPS_PROXY is set
The proxy allows it, because nexus.rhinohealth.com is on its list
Nexus serves its copy, or fetches the package from registry.npmjs.org first
npm installs the package and the lockfile records the mirror's address
practice.why: The VM talks only to the proxy and the mirror. The upstream is reached by Nexus, never by the VM.

practice.q: FCP Lab on the VM needs redis:7.4 from Docker Hub. Which mirror serves it?

options.why: That one serves npm packages only.

options.text: An ECR pull-through cache rule for Docker Hub, reached over the VM's endpoints
options.why: Container images come through ECR, which fetches from Docker Hub on the first pull.
The broker holds GitHub, Jira and Slack keys. It has nothing to do with images.
